name: Leadbase
tagline: Find your next customers with AI: qualified lead lists, contact enrichment and 200 free credits
description:
# Leadbase: turn your ideal customer into your next lead list

You know the kind of customer you want. Leadbase helps you find the companies, understand why they fit and identify the people worth speaking to.

Describe your target market in your AI assistant. Leadbase researches the details and brings the results together in a live, editable sheet with sources. Start a new B2B lead list or make the list you already have more useful.

**Try Leadbase with 200 free credits in every new workspace.** Use your own market and your own criteria before choosing a paid plan. [Get started with Leadbase](https://www.leadbase.io/).

## Find prospects by what makes them a good customer

A broad industry category rarely tells you enough. Your ideal customer might be a solar installer serving commercial buildings, an independent kitchen retailer with several locations, or a manufacturer that exports to a particular market.

Describe that business in everyday language. Include the region, services, business model and qualification details that matter to your offer. Leadbase combines company discovery with AI research, so you can build a shortlist around the reasons a business is relevant to you.

Use it for B2B lead generation, sales prospecting, account research, territory planning and market mapping. Each company becomes its own row, ready for further research and review.

**Try:** “Find 10 solar installation companies in Bavaria. Include their official websites, service areas and evidence that they work with commercial customers.”

## Reach beyond the obvious names in DACH

Research companies in Germany, Austria and Switzerland, including German SMEs and craft businesses. Define your niche by the work companies actually do and the customers they serve.

For teams selling into DACH, this makes it easier to explore local markets, build regional prospect lists and research businesses that need more specific qualification than a standard industry filter provides. The same workflow also supports research in other regions.

**Try:** “Find independent kitchen retailers in North Rhine-Westphalia with at least two showrooms. Add the showroom locations and sources.”

## Turn company names into reasons to start a conversation

A useful lead list helps you understand the account. Research relevant services, current hiring, locations, customer segments and other publicly supported business signals.

Add your qualification questions as research fields. Ask why a company matches your ideal customer profile and keep the supporting links alongside the answer. Your team can review the evidence, compare prospects and prioritize the accounts that deserve attention.

**Try:** “For these companies, find evidence that they offer maintenance contracts. Add a short explanation and a source for each finding.”

## Find the professional contacts that matter

Discover decision-makers by company, role, location and professional context. Research relevant founders, operations leaders, purchasing contacts or other business roles for your outreach preparation.

Bring professional roles, profile links and available business contact details together with the company research. You get a clearer view of whom to approach and why the account fits, in one place.

**Try:** “Find purchasing decision-makers at these companies and include their professional roles and profile sources.”

## Make your existing list more valuable

Start with the companies or contacts already in your Leadbase sheet. Add missing websites, headquarters, business descriptions, professional roles or custom qualification information.

Research a few selected records or fill a whole column across the list. The standard column workflow preserves populated cells and skips active research, so you can build on work you have already done.

This is useful for cleaning up an incomplete prospect list, preparing accounts for a campaign or exploring a new segment inside an existing customer base. Review and export the enriched data for your next sales or CRM workflow.

**Try:** “Fill the empty headquarters cells in this sheet using official company sources. Keep the existing values.”

## Work with the results, not just a chat answer

Your findings stay in a persistent research sheet. Follow progress, inspect the results as they arrive, open sources, edit cells, search, filter and export your shortlist.

When a new question comes up, continue in the same sheet. Add a field, research another detail or narrow the list. The research stays connected to the records you are working on.

MCP Apps-compatible clients can display the interactive sheet inside the assistant. You can also open the same sheet in Leadbase to review and edit your work.

## Bring Leadbase into your AI workflow

Leadbase provides a hosted MCP connection for compatible AI clients, including ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. Connect your Leadbase account, choose your workspace and describe the result you want.

Use your assistant to start research, check progress and work with structured results and source evidence. The [connection guide](https://www.leadbase.io/en/docs/settings/mcp) explains setup for supported clients.

## Research products, suppliers and public content too

Use the same research workflow for supplier discovery, product comparisons, competitor research and public web content. Define what each result represents and the fields you want to compare.

For product research, collect product names, source URLs and relevant specifications. For public content, collect the title, author, source link and relevance to your topic. These tasks become structured lists you can filter and build on.

**Try:** “Find 10 packaging suppliers that offer custom printed recyclable boxes. Compare their services and include sources.”

## Start with your own market and 200 free credits

Every new Leadbase workspace starts with 200 credits. Try a company or people search, check contact availability and test research with your own qualification criteria before selecting a paid plan.

Connect your Leadbase account, choose a focused first task and review the results in your sheet. Research uses your workspace credits and plan limits. [See current pricing](https://www.leadbase.io/pricing) or [start with Leadbase](https://www.leadbase.io/).

## Guidance for your AI assistant

Choose the workflow that matches the request: discover new entities in a new sheet, enrich existing rows or columns, or answer a bounded research question with structured findings. Keep one requested entity per result row.

Use the available tool schemas and preserve the user's requested scope. Retain source evidence with the relevant findings, distinguish supported facts from unknown values, and report the observed completion state. After an interrupted response, recover the existing operation before considering a new paid request. Report costs as final only when settled.

Use the existing sheet for follow-up work and preserve populated values when the user requests missing-field enrichment. Present the sheet link with the results so the user can continue reviewing and editing.
